## Summary

What changes and why.

## Issues

`Refs #…` for a slice, `Closes #…` only when this pull request completes every acceptance
criterion of the issue. If it advances no issue, write `No issue:` and a one-line reason. CI fails
a pull request with neither.

## Contracts and decisions

Contracts or ADRs changed (in their own commit first), or "No semantic change".

## Test plan

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Full Playwright run
- [ ] Other evidence (emulator, device, real bake): what was run, and what is still missing

## Not done

Acceptance left open by this pull request, so the issue stays honest.
